securityGate.surface: untrusted .ocx/.oab declarations, permissions, classifications, secrets and side effects
controls: Strict exact-key, versioned plain-object envelope parser.
Manifest declares keys only; trusted policy supplies permission, trust zone, classification, effects, risk and status.
Unknown, wildcard, duplicate, blocked and unsupported declarations fail closed.
Credential-shaped public metadata is rejected; publisher digest has an exact sha256 format.
Network egress is limited to public_metadata.
Invocation requires an exact permission; wildcard grants do not satisfy it.
Capability fingerprints and whole-registry digest are verified before authorization.
Side effects become Loop 03 approval inputs and are never executed by the adapter.
